title: Carbonda CFR-707 Custom Gravel Build 2026 | Full Presentation & Real Weight

takeaways.text: Early rides on Polish gravel: quick acceleration, precise but not nervous steering and good comfort from 44 mm tires.
In 2026 the owner paid US$1,066 direct for the XS frameset package: frame, fork, two headset options, thru-axles, custom gloss paint to his design, shipping and payment fees.
T700/T800 carbon, threaded BSA bottom bracket, UDH; he chose the conventional-routing headset option for easy service with a mechanical 2×10 GRX group and 44 mm Tufo tires on 27 mm-internal rims.
The XS build weighed 10.1 kg as ridden with pedals, cages, accessory mounts, bell and a trailer-hitch axle (about 9.7 kg stripped), roughly 1 kg less than his previous frame with the same parts.

disclosure: The creator describes his own factory-ordered custom build. Purchase details are owner-reported; other commercial arrangements remain unknown.
summary: Custom CFR707 build with fit, component, weight and ride discussion. The shown configuration and owner-reported costs are not a current mainland China quote or a catalog specification.
